_comment: One credential reaches BOTH flights and hotels: the token from the connect flow (LETSFG_BEARER_TOKEN) or a Developer API key (LETSFG_API_KEY). Connect through the hosted MCP at https://letsfg.co/mcp: the consent step opens letsfg.co/connect: one tap, no card. The card is asked for at the first booking, in a 0.00 Revolut setup (nothing charged). The token searches at once and books once the card is added. Hotels use the same card. If both vars are set the Bearer token is used.

env.LETSFG_BEARER_TOKEN: YOUR_CARD_BACKED_TOKEN_HERE (from the connect flow) — or use LETSFG_API_KEY
